title: w-c205 slice A: control transport classifies proven-unsent failures before the worker hand-off
outcome: ProcessEngramControlTransport tells a request that provably never reached Engram from one dispatched without a valid reply, and that classification reaches the causal failure, availability, accounting and Begin replay consistently.
acceptance: For the control transport, a failure before any byte of the request frame is handed to the control worker is classified proven-unsent, and every failure after that hand-off stays dispatched-without-valid-reply; timeout or cancel alone is never treated as rollback.

A proven-unsent request keeps its original identity and arguments: it does not mark Engram control unavailable, a transport-unsent Begin keeps its transport accounting and protocol disable, and it is resolved only by an identical replay with its original key, never with a newly built identity.
Tests show the classification on both sides of the hand-off boundary and the transport-unsent Begin's disclosure and identical replay through the admission scheduler.
